subtitle.en: The Witness turns one, with a Steam sale, plus the MacOS and iOS ports in the works.
subtitle.zh: 《The Witness》满一岁：Steam 打折，MacOS 与 iOS 移植也在做。

translator.note: 原文里的两处购买地址是纯文本 URL，按原样保留在译文中。

blocks.en: The Witness was first released a year ago.
blocks.zh: 《The Witness》第一次发售是在一年前。

blocks.en: To celebrate, the game is on sale for 50% off on Steam, here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/210970/
blocks.zh: 为了庆祝，游戏正在 Steam 上打五折，地址在这里：http://store.steampowered.com/app/210970/

blocks.en: Braid is also on sale, and if you already own it, you get an extra discount on The Witness: http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2501/
blocks.zh: 《Braid》也在打折，而且如果你已经拥有它，买《The Witness》还能再额外享受一次折扣：http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2501/

blocks.en: Meanwhile, we are working on The Witness for MacOS, and it should be done pretty soon. iOS is also coming up but is a bit further in the future.
blocks.zh: 与此同时，我们正在做 MacOS 版的《The Witness》，应该很快就会完成。iOS 版也在路上了，但要更晚一些。
